headline: Kazakhstan Plans to Double Refined Copper Production by 2030
summary: Kazakhstan aims to double national copper production and expand copper concentrate output 1.5 times by 2030, according to Minister of Industry and Construction Yersayin Nagaspayev.
why: Kazakhstan holds extensive base metal reserves; rising copper output is critical for global electrification, grid modernisation, and electric vehicles.

impacts.name: Copper
impacts.why: Long-term production targets increase expected future global copper refined cathode supplies.
